Hakeem Jeffries has secured the Democratic nomination for House speaker, putting him on course to become the first Black person to hold the position following the party’s sweeping midterm victory. Jeffries won 251 votes in a secret ballot, while 11 Democrats voted against him. As Democrats prepare to lead a House majority during the final two years of Donald Trump’s term, Jeffries pledged to "hold the crooks accountable," hinting at investigations into the Trump administration and its business interests. However, some newly elected progressive lawmakers have sought concessions on issues including US military support for "Israel" and the influence of money in politics. His nomination now awaits a formal vote by the full House on January 3.

🕋 ✝️ ✡️ — Muslims are projected to surpass Christians as the world's largest religious group by 2035, according to new projections from Pew Research Center. By 2070, the global Muslim population is projected to increase by 80%, reaching more than 3.6 billion people and accounting for 36% of the world's population, compared with 26% in 2020. Meanwhile, the Christian population is expected to grow by approximately 30%, reaching nearly 3 billion people while maintaining a relatively stable 29% share of the global population. Sub-Saharan Africa is projected to become the center of global Christianity, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo overtaking the U.S. as the country with the largest Christian population. The U.S. is also projected to lose its Christian majority by 2070, with the Christian share declining from 64% to 48%. The global Jewish population is projected to increase from approximately 15 million to 18 million, with the majority living in Israel.
